faq.q: What time should we depart for a Starlite 2034 pre-concert cruise?
faq.a: We recommend departing Puerto Banús at 18:00 for a 2-hour cruise. You'll return to dock by 20:00, leaving time for a quick taxi ride (15 minutes, €20–€25) to Cantera de Nagüeles. Gates open at 20:00, so you arrive relaxed and on time.

faq.q: Which boats are best for a pre-concert cruise?
faq.a: For a couple or small group, the Dubhe (5 pax, €749/2h) or Mariah SX21 (5 pax) are ideal. For up to 11 guests, the Azimut 39 (11 pax, €749/2h) is excellent value. All include skipper, fuel, drinks, and snacks.

faq.q: How do we get from Puerto Banús to the Starlite venue?
faq.a: A taxi from Puerto Banús to Cantera de Nagüeles takes about 15 minutes and costs €20–€25. Rideshare apps like Uber or Cabify also operate in Marbella. The venue has parking, but a taxi is easier after the concert.

faq.q: What is included in the pre-concert cruise price?
faq.a: Every charter includes a licensed skipper, fuel, water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, light snacks, insurance, safety equipment, and Spanish IVA (21%). No hidden extras.

faq.q: Can we extend the cruise to see the sunset after the concert?
faq.a: Yes, you can book a full-day or evening charter. For example, the Astondoa 40 (€2,299/8h) lets you cruise pre-concert, then return for a late dinner or nightcap. But for Starlite, a 2-hour cruise is plenty.

faq.q: Is the pre-concert cruise suitable for large groups?
faq.a: Absolutely. The Mangusta 80 (12 pax, €4,719 minimum 4h) includes a free jet ski. For 12 guests, the Azimut 58 Flybridge or Ferretti 94 are also available. Contact us via WhatsApp for pricing and availability.

faq.q: What is the best time of year for a Starlite 2034 pre-concert cruise?
faq.a: Starlite 2034 runs July and August. Evening temperatures average 26°C, with sunset around 21:30. A 18:00–20:00 cruise gives you golden hour light and a cool breeze before the concert.

faq.q: Do we need to book the cruise and concert separately?
faq.a: Yes. Concert tickets are sold separately via Starlite's official site. The yacht charter is booked with us. We recommend reserving both 2–3 weeks in advance for peak-season dates.

data.body_html:
Starlite 2034 is Marbella's flagship summer festival, held at the Cantera de Nagüeles amphitheatre. A pre-concert cruise from Puerto Banús turns the evening into a full Mediterranean experience — sunset over La Concha, chilled cava, and a relaxed transfer to the show. This guide covers timings, boat options, and practical logistics so you can plan your Starlite 2034 pre-concert cruise Marbella charter without guesswork.

Why choose a pre-concert cruise for Starlite 2034?

A standard evening at Starlite means arriving by taxi or private car. A pre-concert cruise adds two hours of coastline, drinks, and skyline views before the music starts. You depart Puerto Banús at 18:00, sail past the Golden Mile, see the Sierra Blanca peaks, and return by 20:00. A 15-minute taxi then drops you at the venue gate for 20:30 — well before the 22:00 showtime. It's the difference between rushing and arriving already in holiday mode.

Best boats for your Starlite 2034 pre-concert cruise Marbella

Our fleet offers options for every group size. For couples or small parties, the Dubhe (8m, 5 pax) or Mariah SX21 (6.4m, 5 pax) are nimble and cost-effective. For groups up to 11, the Azimut 39 (12.5m, 11 pax, €749/2h) or Astondoa 40 (12.5m, 9 pax, €749/2h) include all drinks and snacks. If you want extra space, the Mangusta 80 (24m, 12 pax, €4,719 minimum 4h) comes with a free jet ski — ideal if you arrive earlier for a longer day on the water.

All Tier A boats (Astondoa 40, Azimut 39) are priced at €749 for 2 hours, rising to €2,299 for 8 hours. The Mangusta 80 (white or grey) starts at €4,719 for 4 hours. For other boats, contact us via WhatsApp for custom pricing.

Timeline: from Puerto Banús to Starlite

  • 18:00 – Board your yacht at Puerto Banús. Meet your skipper, enjoy welcome drinks.
  • 18:00–20:00 – Cruise east along Marbella's coast. Pass Cabopino and the dunes. Sunset at ~21:30, so you'll have golden light.
  • 20:00 – Return to Puerto Banús dock. Disembark, grab a taxi.
  • 20:15–20:30 – Arrive at Cantera de Nagüeles. Gates open at 20:00.
  • 22:00 – Concert starts. You're seated, relaxed, and ready.

Transport from Puerto Banús to Starlite venue

Cantera de Nagüeles is 8 km east of Puerto Banús. A taxi costs €20–€25 and takes 15 minutes. Rideshare apps like Uber and Cabify operate reliably in Marbella. If you're in a group of 12, consider booking a minibus via our concierge service. The venue has limited parking, so taxis are simpler. After the concert, pre-book a return taxi or use the official Starlite shuttle.

What's included in every charter

Every boat rental includes a licensed skipper, fuel, water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, light snacks, insurance, safety equipment, and Spanish IVA (21%). No hidden fees. You bring only yourselves and concert tickets.

Booking tips for Starlite 2034

Starlite 2034 runs July and August, with evening temperatures around 26°C. Book your yacht charter 2–3 weeks ahead for popular dates. Concert tickets are sold separately via the Starlite website. For large groups (12 pax), the Azimut 58 Flybridge or Ferretti 94 are excellent — contact us via WhatsApp for availability and pricing.
